messages.content: 你能給我盧浮宮博物館未來3個月的展覽資訊嗎？然後告訴我巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳嗎？

function.name: restaurant_info
function.description: Get restaurant information for a specific area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.description: Get exhibition information for a specific museum. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The user wants two things:

1. Exhibition info for Louvre Museum for next 3 months. Use function exhibition_info with museum_name="盧浮宮博物館" and month=3.

2. Restaurant info for Paris region best Italian and Chinese restaurants. Use function restaurant_info twice: first location="巴黎地區" food_type="Italian", second location="巴黎地區" food_type="Chinese".

We need to call the functions. The user didn't specify a particular location within Paris; we can use "巴黎" or "巴黎地區". The function expects location string. We'll pass "巴黎" or "巴黎地區". Let's use "巴黎" as location. The user asked for "巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳". So we can pass location="巴黎" food_type="Italian" and location="巴黎" food_type="Chinese".

We need to call the functions. According to policy, we should call each function separately. We can do multiple calls. The user wants both. So we will call exhibition_info first, then restaurant_info twice. The policy says we can call multiple times. We'll do it.

We need to output the function calls. The assistant should not provide any other text besides the function calls. So we will produce two function calls: one for exhibition_info, then two for restaurant_info. The policy says we should not add any other text. So we will produce the function calls in order.
